body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), volunteered: "The company has already been awarded business of approximately $6.5 million annually by a prominent OEM customer for local supplies in Mexico to start from the fourth quarter of FY'26" Metric: Mexico supplies start. Target: USD 6.5m/yr run-rate from Q4FY26. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (quarter). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: No Mexico supplies in Q4FY26 or Q1-Q2FY27; dispatch started Nov-2026 (Q3FY27). The USD 6.5m/yr figure has not been repeated since Feb-2025. Timeline: Aug-24 'projects start Jan-2026' -> Nov-24 'USD 6.5m from Q4FY26' -> May-25 'Jan-26 start, absolutely on track' -> Aug-25 'warehouse operational Oct-25' -> Nov-25 'operationally ready Oct-25, in line with planned schedule' -> Feb-26 (asked by an analyst) 'waiting for customers to start placing orders ... hopefully next quarter' -> Aug-26 'on track ... first deliveries expected in Q3' -> Nov-26 'first customer dispatch this month', 'single-digit million dollar revenue this year', 1 of 3 customers live. Management explanation: Customer IMMEX registration; customer ramp-up.
